limitations: A still life on a tripod, indoor light; twins differ by the shutter's repeatability and a registration rounded to the pixel; the ideal ratio ignores the demosaicing's correlation, alike for both terms
method: Frames decoded as the application decodes them (signed camera RGB after lens corrections), merged by HdrJob with the middle exposure as reference. Linearity: 16 px block means of the merge against each frame where that frame lies in [0.01, 0.8) of its white and the block is no edge, the frame scaled by the measured exposures; the median against the EXIF exposures gives the measure's gap. Noise: two merges of distinct frames (first and second of each exposure) differ by their noise only, as the reference and its twin do; their deviations over the flatter half of 32 px tiles, per stop of the reference's level, against two ideals: the inverse-variance ratio of the noise laws, and the same weights applied to the variance the twins measure (read, shot and a part proportional to the signal, fitted by least squares)
